title: Drumm's evaluation of the Biondi team's papers

tellings.quote: My original stance when I started looking at this back in 2020 when I was evaluating their original paper was about 50/50.

plain: When a researcher named Filippo Biondi and his team put out their first paper on what lies inside and beneath the Giza pyramids, Geoffrey Drumm, a researcher of the pyramids, judged it about a 50/50 proposition. Drumm tells Michels this about his own review in 2020: "my original stance... was about 50/50." He sets it beside a second paper by the team on the pyramid of Khafre, which suggests his view changed after that.
